Hi, I'M GOLAN

I never planned to become a teacher. I studied chemistry and math at university, and figured I’d spend my adult life transforming molecules. That changed when I joined a university program helping high schoolers prepare for their final exams. Turns out, I really liked teaching.

I watched teens enter the program anxious about math and leave with a sense of success. And contentment, and confidence, and sharpness. At a later point, when they shared how meaningful their journey had been, I I couldn’t have asked for a better job!

For nearly two decades, I have taught math (and sometimes chemistry) across educational institutions and a range of levels, and I always loved it.

Why Yeda began.

Because of this, I started Yeda in order to give that same experience to more teens than I could reach on my own. Each Yeda educator brings their own strengths and talents, and I’m proud to see that each gets the same satisfaction from seeing our students flourish and grow!

And if studying has been making you (or your teen) miserable, or you’ve been feeling like you’re just not good enough — I promise, every one of us at Yeda has been there at some point too. And it doesn’t have to stay that way. Reach out. You might be surprised how fast learning can start feeling different.

A small, trusted team.

I’ve had the privilege of working with families across many countries and cultures, and I bring that global experience and perspective into every student relationship.

Alongside me is a small and trusted team of professionals who see education not just as tutoring, but as a true path to personal growth.

We welcome students only when we’re confident we can make a real difference. That’s how we maintain quality - and why families worldwide trust Yeda to support their teens.

We can't promise that every lesson will be easy, but every lesson matters.

But little by little, changes begin to show: a stronger posture, a spark of satisfaction, a quiet, growing confidence. That’s when we know it’s working.
